en.ServerNote: These settings belong to this server
en.Lead: Settings are kept on the server, for every device connected to it.
en.RSSHubHelp: Subscriptions given as an RSSHub route, such as {route}, are fetched from this address. Leave it empty if you use none.
en.Saved: Saved. The next fetch uses it.
en.RetentionSaved: Saved. Older entries are removed within the hour.
en.InvalidBase: Enter a full http or https address with a host name, such as https://rsshub.app.
en.SaveFailed: Couldn’t save. Check the connection and try again.
en.RetentionHelp: Older entries are removed once an hour, read or not. Starred entries are always kept.
en.OPMLHelp: OPML files move subscriptions between Oriel and other readers.
en.ImportHelp: Adds the subscriptions in an OPML file. Ones you already have are skipped.
en.ExportHelp: Saves every subscription to one OPML file that Oriel and other readers can import.
en.Imported: Imported {file}: {added} added, {existing} already subscribed, {failed} could not be added.
en.InvalidOPML: {file} is not an OPML file. Nothing was added.
en.ImportFailed: Couldn’t import {file}. Check the connection and try again.
en.ExportFailed: Couldn’t export. Check the connection and try again.
en.InvalidURL: Not an http or https address
en.DevicesHelp: Every sign-in is a device. Revoke one to sign it out; it needs the password to connect again.
en.LocalDevices: This computer’s server has no password, so no device signs in to it. Devices show up here when you connect to a server that has one.
en.RevokeBody: It is signed out at once and needs the password to connect again.
en.RevokeFailed: Couldn’t revoke {name}. Check the connection and try again.
en.ErrorHint: The server didn’t answer. Check the connection and try again.

zh-Hans.ServerNote: 这些设置属于这个服务端
zh-Hans.Lead: 设置保存在服务端，连到它的每台设备都一样。
zh-Hans.RSSHubHelp: 只填 RSSHub 路由的订阅（例如 {route}）从这个地址抓取。不用 RSSHub 就留空。
zh-Hans.Saved: 已保存，下次抓取起生效。
zh-Hans.RetentionSaved: 已保存，过期的条目一小时内清理。
zh-Hans.InvalidBase: 填带主机名的完整 http 或 https 地址，例如 https://rsshub.app。
zh-Hans.SaveFailed: 没能保存。检查一下连接再试。
zh-Hans.RetentionHelp: 过期的条目每小时清理一次，已读未读都删。收藏的条目一直保留。
zh-Hans.OPMLHelp: 用 OPML 文件在 Oriel 和别的阅读器之间搬订阅。
zh-Hans.ImportHelp: 添加 OPML 文件里的订阅，已经订阅的跳过。
zh-Hans.ExportHelp: 把所有订阅存成一个 OPML 文件，Oriel 和别的阅读器都能导入。
zh-Hans.Imported: 已导入 {file}：新增 {added} 个，{existing} 个已经订阅，{failed} 个没能添加。
zh-Hans.ImportedOk: 已导入 {file}：新增 {added} 个，{existing} 个已经订阅。
zh-Hans.InvalidOPML: {file} 不是 OPML 文件，什么都没有添加。
zh-Hans.ImportFailed: 没能导入 {file}。检查一下连接再试。
zh-Hans.Exported: 已把 {n} 个订阅导出到 {file}。
zh-Hans.ExportFailed: 没能导出。检查一下连接再试。
zh-Hans.InvalidURL: 不是 http 或 https 地址
zh-Hans.DevicesHelp: 每次登录是一台设备。吊销后它立即退出，要重新输入口令才能连上。
zh-Hans.LocalDevices: 本机的服务端没有设口令，没有设备需要登录。连到设了口令的服务端后，登录过的设备会列在这里。
zh-Hans.RevokeBody: 它会立即退出，要重新输入口令才能连上。
zh-Hans.RevokeFailed: 没能吊销 {name}。检查一下连接再试。
zh-Hans.ErrorHint: 服务端没有响应。检查一下连接再试。
